messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: lisrel in lavaan
parts: I want to get a result like lisrel software in lavaan. What do I do ?

Do you mean you want to view the output in the form of parameter matrices?  Use the lavInspect() function to view the point and SE estimates in their respective matrices: 

example(sem)
lavInspect(fit, "coef")
lavInspect(fit, "se")

If you want the same numerical solution as LISREL provides when fitting equivalent models in both programs, you can try requesting mimic = "lisrel" when you call lavaan (or cfa or sem), but that currently just gets reset to mimic = "EQS".  I wouldn't expect that to change anytime soon -- I am pretty sure there is more interest among lavaan users for new features than for mimicking the software of a previous generation of researchers (no disrespect for Jöreskog or LISREL-users intended). 

Terry
